svg.title: Residual plot patterns
svg.desc: Three residual plots against fitted values: random scatter (good fit), a visible curve (wrong functional form) and a funnel (heteroscedasticity).
svg.text: Three residual plots: only one of them is a good fit
BAD — a curve is left over
A good model leaves no structure behind. Visible structure means information you are throwing away.
The funnel is heteroscedasticity — fix it with a log transform, robust errors, or quantile regression.
